name: Iconix Brand Group, Inc.
note: American brand-management company (New York). Iconix's brands include Umbro. It went private in 2021 when Iconix Acquisition LLC - whose sole member is the Avram Glazer Irrevocable Exempt Trust, per Iconix's Schedule 13D of 25 June 2021 - completed its merger and tender offer (SEC Form 8-K, 4 August 2021). Avram Glazer is the managing member of Lancer Capital LLC.
